decisions.reason: The combined magazining, cleaning and plotting machine was launched only in 2024 and fits the firm's precast concrete automation core, so it will likely get time to win orders, though the quick removal of the 2023 robots shows the firm prunes its portfolio fast.
The production analysis software is cheap to maintain, complements the firm's machinery as a digital add-on and supports customer retention, so dropping it within a year is unlikely.
